boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Rockhurst University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Kansas City food destinations with late availability documented on current official location pages.

cards.title: Pickleman’s Gourmet Cafe — Westport
cards.subtitle: 509 Westport Rd, Kansas City, MO
cards.notes: Use the official location page to confirm the day before leaving; order a sandwich, soup, or pizza for pickup or dine-in.
cards.short_summary: A Westport sandwich-and-pizza counter with especially late Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists hours until midnight Sunday–Thursday and until 4 AM Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours: Sun–Thu 10 AM–12 AM; Fri–Sat 10 AM–4 AM. Confirm before travel because hours can change.

cards.title: Town Topic Hamburgers
cards.subtitle: 2021 Broadway, Kansas City, MO
cards.notes: Choose the Broadway diner when an overnight food option fits the plan; its official page distinguishes lobby, window, and delivery service.
cards.short_summary: A downtown diner with an overnight service schedule published by the business.
cards.evidence_claim: Town Topic’s official contact page lists lobby service to 7:30 PM, window service to 10 PM, and delivery/online ordering from 10 PM to 5 AM at 2021 Broadway.
cards.access_notes: Official page: lobby 5 AM–7:30 PM; window 7:30–10 PM; delivery/online ordering 10 PM–5 AM at 2021 Broadway.

cards.title: El Pueblito
cards.subtitle: 810 Southwest Blvd, Kansas City, MO
cards.notes: Check the weekday before going and use the restaurant’s posted address and phone number to plan a food-only late stop.
cards.short_summary: A Southwest Boulevard Mexican restaurant that posts very late Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: El Pueblito’s official site lists Friday–Saturday hours of 10 AM–4:30 AM and Sunday–Thursday hours ending at midnight.
cards.access_notes: Official posted hours: Sun–Thu 10 AM–12 AM; Fri–Sat 10 AM–4:30 AM. Confirm holiday hours directly.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on Main Street
cards.subtitle: 3907 Main St, Kansas City, MO
cards.notes: Use carryout, curbside, or delivery as listed by the location; check the selected service because delivery availability can differ.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street pizza location with midnight weeknight and 1 AM weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut’s official location page lists hours to midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official restaurant hours: Sun–Thu until 12 AM; Fri–Sat until 1 AM. The page notes delivery hours may vary.

cards.title: Tiki Taco on West 39th
cards.subtitle: 1710 W 39th St, Kansas City, MO
cards.notes: Plan an early-week dinner or a Friday/Saturday late pickup; the business publishes separate closing times for each day.
cards.short_summary: A West 39th Street taco shop with midnight Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Tiki Taco’s official page lists 11 AM–midnight hours on Friday and Saturday at its 1710 W 39th Street location.
cards.access_notes: Official West 39th hours: Mon–Thu 11 AM–11 PM; Fri–Sat 11 AM–12 AM; Sun 11 AM–9 PM.

cards.title: Kona Grill at Country Club Plaza
cards.subtitle: 444 Ward Parkway, Kansas City, MO
cards.notes: Use the location’s reservation or pickup options if useful, and verify the day’s service before heading to the Plaza.
cards.short_summary: A Country Club Plaza restaurant that lists midnight closing every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Kona Grill’s official Kansas City location page lists opening hours of 11:30 AM–12 AM Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official posted hours: 11:30 AM–12 AM daily. Confirm service and holiday changes with the restaurant before travel.

cards.entity_name: Taco Bell — 1310 Emmanuel Cleaver II Blvd
cards.title: Taco Bell on Emmanuel Cleaver II Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 1310 Emmanuel Cleaver II Blvd, Kansas City, MO
cards.notes: Use the official store listing to check its current closing time and choose drive-thru, pickup, or delivery where available.
cards.short_summary: A Kansas City Taco Bell listing marked open late with a 2:30 AM closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official Kansas City locations page lists the 1310 Emmanuel Cleaver II Boulevard restaurant as open until 2:30 AM and identifies drive-thru, delivery, and breakfast.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell restaurants in Kansas City, MO
cards.access_notes: Official listing currently says open until 2:30 AM and marks this location “Open Late.” Recheck before leaving.

cards.title: Wendy’s on East 63rd Street
cards.subtitle: 9708 E 63rd St, Raytown, MO
cards.notes: Treat this as a drive-thru or pickup option and confirm the specific night’s schedule through the official location page.
cards.short_summary: A Raytown Wendy’s with posted midnight hours and 1 AM late-week hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official location page lists restaurant and drive-thru service until midnight Sunday–Wednesday and until 1 AM Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official restaurant and drive-thru hours: Mon–Wed/Sun until 12 AM; Thu–Sat until 1 AM.

cards.title: IHOP on North Chouteau Trafficway
cards.subtitle: 4337 N Chouteau Trafficway, Kansas City, MO
cards.notes: Use the official order or directions links for a round-the-clock breakfast, takeout, curbside, or delivery stop.
cards.short_summary: A Kansas City IHOP officially listed as open 24 hours with multiple service options.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP’s official location page lists this restaurant as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday and identifies dine-in, curbside, online ordering, and late-night food.
cards.access_notes: Official hours: open 24 hours every day. Dine-in, curbside pickup, online ordering, and delivery are listed.

cards.title: IHOP on Northwest Prairie View Road
cards.subtitle: 8541 NW Prairie View Rd, Kansas City, MO
cards.notes: Use this all-hours location when traveling north of campus, and place an order through IHOP’s official location page if desired.
cards.short_summary: A second Kansas City IHOP that publishes 24-hour daily operation.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP’s official location page lists the 8541 NW Prairie View Road restaurant as open 24 hours every day, with dine-in, online ordering, delivery, and late-night food.
cards.access_notes: Official hours: open 24 hours Monday–Sunday. The location lists dine-in, online ordering, delivery, and late-night food.
